questionText: [Q2] Find the odd one out: (Options: January, March...)
explanation: January, March, and July have 31 days each, while November has 30 days.

questionText: [Q3] Find the odd one out: (Options: Square, Rectangle...)
explanation: Square, Rectangle, and Rhombus are two-dimensional (2D) planar figures, whereas Cube is three-dimensional (3D).

questionText: [Q4] Find the odd one out: (Options: Eagle, Bat...)
explanation: Eagle, Ostrich, and Penguin are birds (Aves), whereas Bat is a mammal (Mammalia).

questionText: [Q5] Find the odd one out: (Options: Carrot, Radish...)
explanation: Carrot, Radish, and Beetroot grow underground (root vegetables), while Tomato grows above ground (fruit/fruiting vegetable).

questionText: [Q6] Find the odd one out: (Options: 27, 64...)
explanation: 27 (3³), 64 (4³), and 125 (5³) are perfect cubes, whereas 144 is only a perfect square (12²).

questionText: [Q7] Find the odd one out: (Options: 17, 23...)
explanation: 17, 23, and 29 are prime numbers, whereas 33 is a composite number (3 * 11).

questionText: [Q8] Find the odd one out: (Options: Kathakali, Bharatanatyam...)
explanation: Kathakali, Bharatanatyam, and Odissi are classical dances of India, whereas Bhangra is a folk dance of Punjab.

questionText: [Q9] Find the odd one out: (Options: Eyes, Nose...)
explanation: Eyes, Nose, and Ears are external sensory organs, whereas Heart is an internal organ.

questionText: [Q10] Find the odd one out: (Options: Curd, Butter...)
explanation: Curd, Butter, and Cheese are dairy products derived from milk, whereas Oil is vegetable/plant-derived.
